calls.summary: Gregory Salas from a regional healthcare network called to see the Mitel CX cloud contact center in action for his 40 agent team. Oscar walked him through omnichannel routing and AI-assisted IVR, then booked a live demo for the following week. Gregory confirmed the date and shared his rollout timeline.

Diane Whitfield wanted to modernize her firm's hybrid workforce with MiCollab for voice, video, and messaging in one app. Lila explained the mobile client and presence features, then scheduled a product demo with a solutions engineer. Diane was enthusiastic and asked for pricing to follow.

Anthony Reyes called to check the shipment status of his Mitel 6900 Series SIP desk phones and to confirm the remaining warranty coverage. Rosey located the order, provided a tracking update, and clarified the Software Assurance warranty terms. Anthony was satisfied with the answers.

Marcus Bellamy, opening a new midsize accounting office, called to schedule a consultation for a MiVoice Business phone system across two sites. Lee collected his company name, user count, and preferred deployment model, then booked a demo with the local partner. Marcus confirmed his contact details for the follow up.

Patricia Nunez asked about MiContact Center Enterprise for her financial services support line and wanted to compare it against her current contact center setup. Mary outlined skills-based routing and reporting, then set up a demo with a specialist. Patricia agreed and picked a morning slot.

Kevin Ostrander wanted to add MiCollab licenses for remote staff and see how it ties into his existing desk phones. Sue reviewed his current plan and booked a demo to show the mobile and video features. Kevin confirmed he would join with two colleagues.

Rachel Kimura reported that her new SIP DECT handsets lost connection during the warehouse installation and staff could not roam between floors. Mike ran through the base station setup and opened a service ticket for an onsite technician. Rachel remained frustrated about the delay.

Daniel Foster disputed a charge on his latest Software Assurance billing statement, saying the renewal amount was higher than quoted. Jennifer reviewed the invoice, explained the annual percentage tied to license value, and escalated the billing discrepancy for review. Daniel wanted a callback with a correction.

Laura Pham called about a warranty repair for a conference phone in a meeting room that had failed audio on one side. Rose confirmed the unit was still covered and arranged a replacement shipment. Laura was relieved but noted the outage had disrupted several meetings.

Steven Alvarado was comparing MiVoice Business against a competitor for a manufacturing plant and asked to see reliability and hybrid options firsthand. Oscar answered his questions and scheduled a demo despite some hesitation on price. Steven agreed to attend and requested a proposal afterward.

Monica Reyes complained that her OpenScape Business installation had been delayed twice and her small office was still without a working phone system. Lila apologized, checked the partner schedule, and pushed for an expedited installation date. Monica remained unhappy about the missed timelines.

Brian Coleman called upset over a duplicate billing charge for user licenses he said he had already cancelled last quarter. Lee pulled the account, confirmed the error, and opened a billing adjustment request with a credit. Brian demanded written confirmation before ending the call.

Angela Brooks called to cancel her Mitel Secure Cloud subscription because her organization was consolidating vendors. Mary attempted to retain the account and explain the sovereign hosting benefits, but Angela insisted on the cancel request. The account was flagged for a retention specialist.

Thomas Nguyen called after hours to report that his contact center queue had dropped calls during peak hours and no one answered. The call rolled to voicemail without reaching an agent. He left an angry message demanding an urgent callback about the outage.

Victoria Salinas called furious about repeated service issues and wanted to cancel her entire MiVoice Business contract immediately. Sue tried to de-escalate and offer a support review, but Victoria refused and asked for a manager. The call ended without resolution and was escalated.

prompts.question: Is the customer trying to solve a specific problem?
prompts.answer: Yes. The caller is a healthcare IT manager seeking to modernize their on-premises PBX system and enable remote work capabilities across multiple clinic locations. They are frustrated with system inflexibility and want to evaluate cloud and hybrid deployment options.

prompts.question: What are the customer's expectations?
prompts.answer: The caller expects a detailed technical demo showing how Mitel's UC platform integrates with their existing Microsoft infrastructure and supports their distributed workforce. They also want clarity on security and compliance features for healthcare environments.

prompts.question: How could the agent handle the call better?
prompts.answer: The agent did well structuring the intake and scheduling the demo, but missed capturing the email address and failed to set expectations about pre-demo questionnaire or required participants. A brief mention of what materials to gather before the demo would have improved engagement.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Mitel. My name is Marcus Bell. May I have your name please?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Marcus, this is Jennifer Chen. I'm the IT director at Evergreen Health Systems.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Jennifer, thanks for reaching out. We're excited to help. Can you tell me what brings you to Mitel today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: We're currently on an older on-premises system that just isn't keeping up. We have three clinic locations and staff working from home now. We need something more flexible, ideally cloud or hybrid.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand. Hybrid and cloud flexibility are exactly what our Unified Communications platform delivers. Just to confirm, are you looking for voice, collaboration, or an integrated solution across both?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Both. We also have a small contact center handling patient intake calls, so we'd benefit from a solution that covers both unified communications and basic contact center capabilities.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's perfect. MiVoice Business combined with our Mitel CX platform covers exactly that scenario. Before I schedule your demo, let me get a couple more details. What is your approximate employee count?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: We have about 150 employees across the three clinics, with roughly 40 in our central office handling calls.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent. And are all three locations in the same geographic area, or spread across different states?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: All in the Pacific Northwest. We're based in Portland, Oregon.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect. So to confirm, I'll set up a technical demo of our UC and contact center solutions tailored for healthcare. Let me get your phone number to send confirmation details.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Got it. And your best email for follow-up?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Actually, just send everything to our main IT email. Our internal team will coordinate from there.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great, Jennifer. I've scheduled your demo for January 19 at 2:00 PM Pacific. A specialist will walk you through security, compliance features for healthcare, and how Teams integration works. Thanks for choosing Mitel.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have a great day.

callDetail.aiSummary: Jennifer Chen, IT director at Evergreen Health Systems, called to evaluate Mitel's UC and contact center solutions for three clinic locations in the Portland, Oregon area. Her organization is looking to migrate from an outdated on-premises PBX to a hybrid or cloud platform to support remote work and distributed staff. The agent successfully captured her primary needs, confirmed the requirement for both unified communications and light contact center capabilities, and scheduled a technical demo for January 19. However, the agent did not secure the caller's direct email address, which may impact follow-up efficiency.

comment.author: Kyle Paklaian
comment.text: @Marcus great structure and intake discipline on this call. You qualified the vertical, confirmed cloud interest, and booked the demo smoothly. Two coaching notes for next time. First, when the caller defers to a shared IT email, gently push back and get at least one direct contact. Shared inboxes create demo no-shows. Second, use the final 15 seconds to set expectations, something like 'Before the demo, our team will send a quick IT discovery questionnaire and a link to our healthcare compliance overview. Just review those so we can maximize our time together.' This primes the customer and shows professionalism.

transcript.text: Thank you for calling Mitel, this is Rachel on the business communications team. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Rachel. We're a growing insurance firm, about 60 staff across two offices, and our current phone setup is really showing its age. I'm looking at replacing the whole thing.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Happy to help with that. Can I get your name and a bit about what you have in place right now?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sure, it's Daniel Okafor. We're on an old on-premises PBX that keeps dropping calls, and half the team is remote now so it just doesn't fit how we work anymore.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks Daniel. Given the remote split and two sites, I'd point you toward MiVoice Business as your call platform paired with MiCollab so your people get voice, video, messaging, and presence in one app on any device.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Okay, that sounds like the right direction. What does something like that run per person? I want to keep this manageable, we're not a huge company.
highlights: What does something like that run per person
I want to keep this manageable

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Completely understand. MiVoice Business typically lands around twenty five to forty five dollars per user each month, and MiCollab adds roughly twenty to thirty five, though your partner tailors the quote to your licensing and volume so you're not overbuying.
highlights: twenty five to forty five dollars per user

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Right. To be honest I'm getting a couple of quotes on this. The team at RingCentral gave me a number last week, so I'm weighing my options.
highlights: I'm getting a couple of quotes

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's smart, and I'd encourage it. Where Mitel stands apart is deployment flexibility. We can do cloud, hybrid, or keep some on-premises, so you migrate at your own pace instead of ripping everything out at once. That tends to be the deciding factor for firms like yours.
highlights: cloud, hybrid, or keep some on-premises

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: That flexibility matters, our compliance people would want some data kept in-house. One thing though, I don't want to get locked into a long commitment if it doesn't work out.
highlights: I don't want to get locked into a long commitment

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Understood, and we can walk through term options that keep you comfortable. Many customers start hybrid and expand once they see the reliability firsthand. Nothing forces you all in on day one.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Good. I'd also want to know about desk phones for the front office, the receptionists still want physical handsets.
highlights: desk phones for the front office

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Easy add. The Mitel 6900 Series IP Phones give you HD audio and color displays, and they pair right into MiVoice Business. Let me set you up with a personalized demo so an engineer can show all of this against your two-site setup. Does Thursday at 10 AM work?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Thursday at 10 works for me. Let me just confirm my partner can join, but pencil us in.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Done, Daniel, you're booked for Thursday at 10 AM and I'll send a calendar invite you can forward. Thanks so much for calling Mitel, we'll talk soon.

Qualify one question at a time: I'll ask a few quick questions one at a time, first how many users or agents you need to support, then which solution fits best (unified communications like MiCollab, a business platform like MiVoice Business, or a contact center like Mitel CX), then your preferred deployment model (cloud, hybrid, or on-premises), then your ideal go-live timeline, and finally your business ZIP code so I can confirm partner coverage and availability.

Estimate then book: Once I confirm we cover your ZIP code, I'll share a preliminary per-user or per-agent price range based on what you shared, then recommend a live demo with a Mitel solutions specialist for an exact quote. I can propose a specific day and time, and you'll get a reminder text before the appointment with a number to call.

qaPairs.question: What is the difference between MiCollab and MiVoice Business?
qaPairs.answer: MiVoice Business is the underlying IP call-control platform for voice and mobility, while MiCollab is the single-app client that adds voice, video, messaging, and presence on top of it. A specialist can map both to your setup on a quick demo, which I'd be glad to book.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer a cloud phone system?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Mitel supports flexible cloud, hybrid, and on-premises deployment models across our platforms and Mitel Secure Cloud. Let's set up a demo so a specialist can recommend the right model for you.

qaPairs.question: Can Mitel integrate with Microsoft Teams?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our Microsoft Teams Integration embeds Mitel enterprise voice and PBX calling directly inside Teams. I can arrange a demo to walk you through how it works for your team.

qaPairs.question: How much does MiVoice Business cost?
qaPairs.answer: Pricing depends on your user count, deployment model, and licensing, so it varies by configuration. The best next step is a demo where a specialist can build an accurate quote for you.

qaPairs.question: What contact center solutions do you offer?
qaPairs.answer: We offer Mitel CX for cloud omnichannel routing and IVR, plus MiContact Center Enterprise for large-scale skills-based routing and reporting. A demo is the best way to see which fits your agent volume, and I can schedule one.

qaPairs.question: Do you support hybrid deployments?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Mitel is built for hybrid communications so you can blend cloud and on-premises as needed. Let's book a demo so a specialist can design a hybrid approach for you.

qaPairs.question: Can I keep my existing desk phones?
qaPairs.answer: Many Mitel and OpenScape phones carry forward, and we also offer the 6900 Series, SIP, DECT, and conference phones. A specialist can confirm compatibility on a demo, which I can set up.

qaPairs.question: What is Mitel CX?
qaPairs.answer: Mitel CX is our cloud contact center with omnichannel routing, IVR, and AI-assisted customer experience tools. I'd recommend a demo so you can see it in action, and I can arrange that.

qaPairs.question: Do you have solutions for healthcare?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we serve healthcare with secure, compliant communications and EHR-integrated critical communications solutions. Let's schedule a demo tailored to your healthcare environment.

qaPairs.question: What is Revolution used for?
qaPairs.answer: Revolution is our mass notification and emergency alerting solution that reaches devices and endpoints across a site. A specialist can scope it for your facilities on a demo, which I can book.

qaPairs.question: How many users can Mitel support?
qaPairs.answer: Our platforms scale from small business up to large enterprises, and Mitel serves 70 million users across 100+ countries. A demo will let a specialist right-size a solution for you.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer managed services?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our Professional and Managed Services span Advise, Transform, Operate, and Optimize offerings. I can set up a demo to review which service tier fits your needs.

qaPairs.question: Can I get a softphone for remote workers?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Unify Phone is a cloud-connected softphone that bridges desk phones with mobile and remote work. Let's book a demo so a specialist can configure it for your team.

qaPairs.question: Is Mitel secure and compliant?
qaPairs.answer: Mitel emphasizes reliability, security, and offers Mitel Secure Cloud for regulated and sovereign requirements. A specialist can walk through compliance details on a demo I can schedule.

qaPairs.question: What is OpenScape Business?
qaPairs.answer: OpenScape Business is an all-in-one unified communications platform designed for small and midsize businesses. I'd suggest a demo to see if it fits your size, and I can arrange one.

qaPairs.question: Do you provide analytics and reporting?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our contact center and workforce optimization tools include advanced analytics, quality management, and reporting. Let's set up a demo so you can see the dashboards.

qaPairs.question: How long does deployment take?
qaPairs.answer: Timelines vary by solution, deployment model, and scale, so it depends on your requirements. A specialist can outline a realistic timeline on a demo, which I can book for you.

qaPairs.question: Do you work through partners?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Mitel sells through a global network of 6,000+ trusted partners who help deploy and support your solution. I can connect you with the right partner through a demo.

qaPairs.question: Can Mitel help me migrate to the cloud?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our Migrate to the Cloud approach lets you move at your own pace with cloud or hybrid options. Let's schedule a demo so a specialist can plan your migration path.

qaPairs.question: How do I get a quote?
qaPairs.answer: Quotes are built around your user count, deployment model, and features, so a specialist prepares them for you. The fastest way is to book a demo, and I can set that up right now.
